name: read_output
description: Read a kept output page by page: the output of a command, or a long tool result, whose result named its id (o- and 16 hex characters). You get its lines, then a last line that says where the next page starts. The same id and offset give the same page: a third call in a row with the same arguments, after two identical results, is not run. Example: {"id":"o-3f9c2a17b0d4e8a1","offset":2001}

id.description: The output id from the result that kept it

offset.description: First line, from 1; -50 = the last 50 lines
